description: This file defines the MailTransport class which extends AbstractTransport and manages email transport configurations and sending emails in the OrangeHRM system. It supports SMTP, secure SMTP, and sendmail protocols, and provides methods to set credentials and encryption options.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A custom mail transport class extending Symfony's AbstractTransport, responsible for configuring and sending emails via different protocols like SMTP and sendmail.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport object with specified scheme, host, and port, setting up the transport accordingly.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads the transport configuration based on the current parameters, creating a transport object from DSN details.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures encryption options for the SMTP connection, disabling peer verification if TLS is not used.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Sends the email message using the configured transport.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport configuration.
